The **Mysterious Guidestones** are an unmarked location in the Savage Divide region of Appalachia. They are located northeast of Federal Disposal Field HZ-21.

Due to their unknown nature, some speculated that they were of extraterrestrial origins. [1] 

Located on the top of mountain, the guidestones consist of one upright standing, central stone slab in the middle and four standing slabs around it. The central slab has a horizontal stone on top of it, while the outer slabs have petroglyhps on both their front and back sides.

The Mysterious Guidestones appear in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Wastelanders* update.

In Nifskope, the author of the Mysterious Guidestones is Connor McCampbell.
